about_the_game:
Real-time planetary collision sandbox powered by SPH physics: smash planets together and watch the destruction and rebirth of new worlds unfold.

Space Crash Simulator is a pure sandbox experience where you can design and observe spectacular astrophysical events. Place planets on a grid, set their velocity vectors, and adjust key parameters like particle count, particle mass, viscosity, and spin.

Customize each planet with different textures — or use your own images for truly unique worlds. You can even introduce a “black hole particle” with immense mass that tears nearby planets apart.

The simulator features several modes to explore different cosmic scales:

  • 🌍 2 Body Mode – simple head-on or glancing planetary impacts.

  • 🌗 3 Body Mode – chaotic multi-body interactions.

  • ☀️ Protoplanetary Disk + Star Mode – formation and accretion dynamics.

  • 🌌 Galaxy Mode – collide entire galaxies and watch their cores dance. (Note: for performance reasons, this mode simulates gravity between galactic centers only, without full SPH fluid dynamics.)

Watch as matter melts, merges, and reforms under real physical laws — powered entirely by GPU-based Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics.

  • OS: macOS 10.15 (or newer)
  • Processor: Intel/Apple Silicon 2+ Cores (1.7GHz and above)

  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 or Metal
